title: Fur Friends ⚔️ Battle Edition Day 17 | The Grand Arena | Cozy Kawaii RPG Animation & Lofi
description:
The Fur Friends enter the Grand Arena tournament! A mighty roar turns out to be Tora the Berserker, the loudest and friendliest tiger in Pawlandia. She joins the team, they win the team round against the Champion Golem, and celebrate with cupcakes and fireworks.

0:00 The Arena Tournament
0:45 Tora the Berserker
1:30 The Champion
2:15 Victory Feast

⚔️ Fur Friends: Battle Edition — the Fur Friends are adventuring in Pawlandia Online, a cozy fantasy MMORPG world. A new friend joins every episode!
🐾 No one gets hurt: bonked monsters just get dizzy, then become friends.
🎧 Best with headphones. Original lofi music & cozy fantasy sounds.
